studies.title: 11 diesel islands: a first screen (post hoc)
studies.question: Which diesel islands could use solar or wind?
studies.text: Sun, wind, rivers and the nearest town for 11 islands named in the press as running a diesel plant. Only Karimunjawa is costed: it is the only island with an hourly load.
